# `aitbc agent verify-identity`

Verify an agent's identity using a verifier address on the blockchain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent verify-identity [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | The Agent id. |
| `--verifier-address` | text | — | yes | The Verifier address. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent verify-identity --agent-id <agent_id> --verifier-address <verifier_address>
```
